relations.text: 2022年にAllianz Global Investorsの運用チームを取得し、海外販売の戦略的提携を結ぶ

relations.text: Alightが10-Kで、主な競合の一社としてVoyaを挙げる
relations.text_en: Alight names Voya among its primary competitors

source.label: Alight 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors include Accolade, ADP, bswift, Businessolver, Conduent, Empower, Fidelity, Included Health, HealthEquity, Mercer, Personify, Sedgwick, Quantum Health, Voya, and WTW.

relations.text: CNOが10-Kで、職域向け補完医療保険の主な競合としてVoyaを挙げる

source.quote: Our main competitors for supplemental health products sold through our Worksite Division include AFLAC, subsidiaries of Unum, MetLife, Chubb/Combined, and Voya.
